reason: $38 for a tee is double what I pay at Uniqlo or H&M, and I've never heard of Northline. I'm not putting money on a brand with no real customer reviews or photos I can check.
objection: There's nothing here I can verify. No customer photos, no reviews, no way to see how a 240gsm boxy tee actually fits or holds up after a wash, and I'd be paying Uniqlo-plus prices on the brand's word alone.
would_change_my_mind: A bunch of real customer reviews with photos showing the fit and fabric after washing, plus a tee closer to $25 or an easy free return so I'm not stuck with it.
